name: Kedesh
brief: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city of refuge in Naphtali
short: Kedesh (Kedesh-naphtali), a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, became a Levitical city and a city of refuge in the territory of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 12:22; 19:37; 20:7; 21:32">Joshua 12:22; 19:37; 20:7; 21:32</ref>).
